tagline.zh: 汇报、展示、看板、路演的效果参考
tagline.en: Reference library for reporting, demos, dashboards and roadshows

intro.zh: 这里收的不是好看的截图，而是做法。每个案例都写清楚它好在哪、能直接抄什么、有没有现成的开源件。
intro.en: Not screenshots — methods. Every entry says what makes it good, what to copy, and whether there is a ready-made open-source piece.

rule.zh: 看板用图表引擎，复盘用滚动叙事，演示用左右分栏，正式场合用幻灯片。四类不要混在一页里。
rule.en: Dashboards use chart engines, reviews use scroll narratives, demos use side-by-side panels, formal occasions use slides. Never mix all four on one page.

desc.zh: 七种可以直接用的手段。每一项都是一种效果。
desc.en: Seven techniques you can use directly. Each one is a specific effect.

desc.zh: 用来找东西的地方，本身不是做法。灵感榜、界面库、行业来源都在这里。
desc.en: Places to go looking. Not techniques in themselves: galleries, UI libraries and industry sources.

what.zh: 早会 / 周会动态看板

how.zh: 单文件 HTML 加图表引擎；数据每周换，版式不动。
how.en: One self-contained HTML file plus a chart engine; data changes weekly, layout does not.

ref.zh: FT 视觉新闻 · Reuters Graphics

how.zh: 滚动叙事长页：画布钉住，滚到哪一步就揭示哪一步。
how.en: A scroll narrative: pin the canvas and reveal one step per scroll.

how.zh: 左右分栏：一边界面、一边代码，逐步高亮。
how.en: Two columns: interface on one side, code on the other, highlighted step by step.

ref.zh: Expo Snack · Apple SwiftUI 教程

what.en: A prototype the audience clicks through

how.zh: 做成交互式数据应用，不打包、发个链接就能用。
how.en: Build an interactive data app: no packaging, one link and it runs.

what.zh: 对外报告 / 路演长页

how.zh: 可交互年报式排版，图文跟随滚动。
how.en: Annual-report layout with interaction, images and text following the scroll.

how.zh: 用 Markdown 写幻灯片，动效克制。
how.en: Slides written in Markdown, with restrained motion.

ref.en: The pacing of an Apple keynote

how.zh: 金融专用图表，交互对齐交易软件。
how.en: Finance-specific charts with interaction matching trading software.

what.zh: 界面观感想上一个台阶
what.en: Lifting the look of the interface

how.zh: 换掉组件底座，把配色和字号收敛成一套变量。
how.en: Swap the component base and consolidate colour and type into one set of tokens.

desc.zh: 把一个流程或一个系统，用滚动一屏一屏讲清楚。适合项目复盘、系统汇报。
desc.en: Walk through a process or a system one screen at a time as the reader scrolls. For project reviews and system walkthroughs.

why.zh: 把长页面切成一个个场景，滚动驱动切换，这个团队的官网用的就是同一套引擎。
why.en: Splits a long page into scenes and drives the switch with scroll. The studio's own site runs on this same engine.

steal.zh: 场景怎么切分、固定画布加进度指示
steal.en: How scenes are carved up; pinned canvas plus progress indicator

why.zh: 代码逐行讲解、逐行高亮的引擎。要边讲边演示代码，这是最省力的一条路。
why.en: An engine for line-by-line code walkthroughs and highlights. The least effort way to explain code as you present it.

steal.zh: 行内注释、高亮、分步骤推进的组合
steal.en: Inline annotations, highlights and step-by-step advance

why.zh: 把「滚到第几步」变成状态变量的轻量库，做分步揭示最省事。
why.en: Turns 'which step are we on' into a state variable. The easiest way to build step-by-step reveals.

steal.zh: 滚动位置到步骤的映射写法
steal.en: Mapping scroll position to a step index

why.zh: 在 Quarto 里写滚动叙事的扩展，报告和网页可以共用一份源文件。
why.en: A Quarto extension for scroll narratives, so the report and the web page share one source file.

steal.zh: 一份 Markdown 同时产出报告和网页
steal.en: One Markdown file producing both report and site

why.zh: 滚动一句一个画面，图随滚动放大缩小，把发布会的节奏搬到了网页上。
why.en: One sentence per screen; images scale as you scroll. Launch-event pacing, moved onto the web.

steal.zh: 首屏文案的结构、逐句替换的排版
steal.en: The hero copy structure; sentence-by-sentence replacement

why.zh: 极简底色、大留白、克制的动效，最能体现「贵」的一种做法。
why.en: Minimal ground, generous whitespace, restrained motion. The clearest way to signal production value.

steal.zh: 留白比例与字体层级
steal.en: Whitespace ratio and type hierarchy

why.zh: 深色、大字、动效克制，是产品感最强的一类官网。
why.en: Dark, large type, restrained motion. The strongest example of product-feel on a marketing site.

steal.zh: 首屏三行文案怎么写、快捷键演示动画
steal.en: How to write a three-line hero; how to animate a keyboard shortcut

why.zh: 技术产品的官网范式，把抽象的东西画成一眼看懂的图。
why.en: A template for technical product sites: abstract concepts drawn as diagrams you get at a glance.

steal.zh: 用示意图讲架构，而不是用文字堆
steal.en: Explaining architecture with diagrams instead of paragraphs

why.zh: 长期被当作企业官网的设计标杆，信息密度高但不乱。
why.en: A long-standing benchmark for corporate sites: high information density without the mess.

steal.zh: 分栏节奏、产品截图的呈现方式
steal.en: Column rhythm; how product screenshots are framed

desc.zh: 左边界面、右边代码，改一行看一行。做产品演示、技术分享时最直观。
desc.en: Interface on one side, code on the other, change a line and watch it land. The clearest format for product and technical demos.

why.zh: 左边写代码，右边手机里实时跑起来。最接近「左边手机、右边敲代码」这个画面的现成工具。
why.en: Code on the left, a live phone running it on the right. The closest off-the-shelf match to the split-screen demo you described.

steal.zh: 直接当演示台用，改一行看一行
steal.en: Use it as the demo stage; change a line, show the result

why.zh: 把「代码加实时预览」嵌进你自己任何网页里。
why.en: Embeds code plus live preview into any page you already own.

steal.zh: 嵌进内部文档，做成可交互的说明页
steal.en: Embed in internal docs to make an interactive explainer

why.zh: 在浏览器里跑完整前端工程，连依赖安装都不用配。
why.en: Runs a full front-end project in the browser, no dependency setup needed.

steal.zh: 发一个链接就能演示，不配环境
steal.en: Share one link and demo, with no environment setup

why.zh: 左边代码、右边实时预览、分步骤高亮，这类演示的教科书。
why.en: Code left, live preview right, step-by-step highlighting. The textbook version of this format.

steal.zh: 步骤导航和当前步骤高亮的交互
steal.en: Step navigation and current-step highlighting

why.zh: 改样式即时看到结果，现场调界面最快的方式。
why.en: Change a style and see it immediately. The fastest way to adjust a layout live.

steal.zh: 开会时当场改给领导看
steal.en: Editing the design live in a meeting

desc.zh: 每周或每天更新的那一类，重点是数据换、版式不动，所以模板化比好看更重要。
desc.en: For weekly or daily refreshes the priority is that data changes while the layout does not. Templating matters more than looks.

why.zh: 成熟的开源看板平台，接上数据库就能出图，不用自己写前端。
why.en: A mature open-source dashboard platform: connect a database and chart, with no front-end work.

steal.zh: 图表组合、筛选器布局、权限思路
steal.en: Chart sets, filter layout, permission model

why.zh: 监控场景最强，实时刷新和阈值告警的看板做得最顺。
why.en: Strongest for monitoring: live refresh and threshold alerts are the smoothest here.

steal.zh: 自动刷新、阈值变色的呈现方式
steal.en: Presenting auto-refresh and threshold colouring

why.zh: 非技术同事也能自己拖出图的 BI 工具。
why.en: A BI tool non-technical colleagues can drag a chart out of themselves.

steal.zh: 让同事自助取数的组织方式
steal.en: Organising self-service access for colleagues

why.zh: 写 SQL 直接出图，最适合数据人自己快速搭一版。
why.en: Write SQL, get charts. Best for a quick self-built version by whoever holds the data.

steal.zh: 查询与图表的绑定方式
steal.en: How queries bind to charts

why.zh: 建在 dbt 上的看板，指标定义和看板同源，不容易出现两套口径。
why.en: Dashboards built on dbt, so metric definitions and charts share one source of truth.

steal.zh: 指标口径统一的做法
steal.en: Keeping metric definitions consistent

why.zh: 写 Markdown 加 SQL 就直接生成看板，最适合每周更新的汇报。
why.en: Markdown plus SQL produces the dashboard. The best fit for a weekly-updated report.

steal.zh: 把周报写成模板，数据换文件不换版式
steal.en: Turning the weekly report into a template: swap data, keep the layout

why.zh: 用 Markdown 生成数据报告和数据应用，可以导出成静态页面。
why.en: Markdown generates data reports and data apps, exportable as static pages.

steal.zh: 对外报告、可交互专题
steal.en: External reports and interactive features

why.zh: 半天就能做出「能点」的演示应用，参数一改图表跟着变。
why.en: Half a day gets you a clickable demo app where charts follow the parameters.

steal.zh: 给领导试参数的那种演示
steal.en: Demos where the audience tries the parameters

why.zh: 交互式数据应用框架，联动筛选做得比 Streamlit 更细。
why.en: An interactive data app framework with finer cross-filtering than Streamlit.

steal.zh: 多图联动的写法
steal.en: Wiring several charts to each other

why.zh: 一份源码同时出报告、网页、幻灯片和 PDF。
why.en: One source produces the report, the site, the slides and the PDF.

steal.zh: 汇报材料多形态统一输出
steal.en: One report in several output formats

desc.zh: 图表引擎本身。选一个主力就够，换来换去只会让几份材料长得不像同一套。
desc.en: The chart engines themselves. Pick one as the workhorse; switching between them makes your material look unrelated.

why.zh: 国内最稳的图表引擎，中文排版和交互都最省心，升级现有看板的首选。
why.en: The most dependable engine for Chinese-language charts, and the first choice for upgrading an existing dashboard.

steal.zh: 主题配色、tooltip 与图例的中文排版
steal.en: Theme palettes; Chinese typography in tooltips and legends

why.zh: 自由度最高的可视化底层，别人做不出来的图靠它。
why.en: The most flexible visualisation layer, for charts nobody else can produce.

steal.zh: 需要非常规图表时再上，学习成本高
steal.en: Reach for it only for unusual charts; the learning curve is steep

why.zh: 配 React 最顺手的图表库，组件化写法，改起来快。
why.en: The smoothest chart library for React: component-shaped, quick to adjust.

steal.zh: 把图表当普通组件拼装
steal.en: Treating charts as ordinary components

why.zh: 科学计算类图表最全，三维和统计图不用另找库。
why.en: The most complete for scientific charts; 3D and statistical plots included.

steal.zh: 统计分布类图表的画法
steal.en: Statistical and distribution charts

why.zh: 金融与商业报告里的老牌选择，图表交互打磨得很细。
why.en: A long-standing choice for financial and business reports, with finely polished interaction.

steal.zh: 图表内的交互与导出功能
steal.en: In-chart interaction and export features

why.zh: 蚂蚁的可视化语法，做叙事型图表和看板都合适。
why.en: Ant Group's grammar of graphics, good for both narrative charts and dashboards.

steal.zh: 图表分层与标注的写法
steal.en: Layering and annotation in charts

why.zh: 用一段 JSON 描述图表，不改代码就能换图，适合批量出图。
why.en: Describe a chart in JSON and swap it without touching code. Good for generating charts in bulk.

steal.zh: 图表配置与数据分离
steal.en: Separating chart config from data

why.zh: 几行代码出一张讲究的图，默认样式就很像出版物。
why.en: A polished chart in a few lines; the defaults already look like print.

steal.zh: 默认样式与留白，直接拿来当基准
steal.en: Default styling and whitespace as a baseline

why.zh: 最轻便的入门库，常规折线柱状饼图几分钟就能上。
why.en: The lightest starting point: ordinary line, bar and pie charts in minutes.

steal.zh: 简单图表不要过度设计
steal.en: Not over-designing simple charts

why.zh: TradingView 出的金融图表，K 线、净值曲线、回撤区间专用。
why.en: TradingView's finance charts, built for candlesticks, NAV curves and drawdown bands.

steal.zh: 组合净值走势、回撤区间标注
steal.en: NAV curves and drawdown band annotations

why.zh: 专做看板卡片的组件库，指标加迷你趋势图的组合很舒服。
why.en: Components made for dashboard cards; the metric-plus-sparkline pairing reads well.

steal.zh: 指标卡片的风格与信息密度
steal.en: Metric card style and information density

why.zh: 国产可视化套件，叙事型图表和看板都有现成件。
why.en: A Chinese visualisation suite with ready-made narrative charts and dashboards.

steal.zh: 滚动叙事的图表写法
steal.en: Charts that work inside a scroll narrative

desc.zh: 正式场合还是幻灯片，但可以用 Markdown 写，改起来比 PPT 快得多。
desc.en: Formal occasions still call for slides, but Markdown produces them and they are far faster to edit than a PPT.

why.zh: Markdown 写幻灯片，代码高亮最好，适合技术类汇报。
why.en: Slides in Markdown with the best code highlighting, made for technical talks.

steal.zh: 一份 md 出正式演示稿
steal.en: One Markdown file producing a formal deck

why.zh: 网页幻灯片的鼻祖，插件生态最全。
why.en: The original web slide framework, with the broadest plugin ecosystem.

steal.zh: 讲解备注、分栏、图表插件
steal.en: Speaker notes, columns and chart plugins

why.zh: 用 React 写幻灯片，方便把自己做的图表组件直接嵌进去。
why.en: Slides written in React, so your own chart components drop straight in.

steal.zh: 把看板嵌进演示页
steal.en: Embedding a dashboard in a deck

why.zh: Markdown 一键转 PDF 或 PPT，最省事的一条路。
why.en: Markdown to PDF or PPTX in one command. The least effort route.

steal.zh: 快速出正式 PDF 交上去
steal.en: Producing a formal PDF to hand over

why.zh: 三维空间演示，回头率最高。
why.en: Three-dimensional presentations. The highest attention yield.

steal.zh: 开场用一次，别全程用
steal.en: Use once at the opening, never throughout

why.zh: 现成的 HTML 幻灯片模板，样式完整，改文案就能用。
why.en: A complete HTML slide template. Change the copy and it is usable.

steal.zh: 没有时间自己排时的起点
steal.en: A starting point when there is no time to design

why.zh: 生成式演示工具，临时场合出稿最快。
why.en: A generative deck tool, fastest for last-minute occasions.

steal.zh: 救急用，正式稿还是自己排
steal.en: For emergencies; formal decks are still worth laying out yourself

why.zh: 模板质量明显高于自带 PPT，协作也顺。
why.en: Noticeably better templates than bundled slide software, and smoother collaboration.

steal.zh: 找好看版式的起点
steal.en: A starting point for a well-designed layout

why.zh: 权威报告的版式与图表规范，章节结构值得抄。
why.en: Layout and chart conventions from an authoritative report; the chapter structure is worth copying.

steal.zh: 章节结构、图表注释写法
steal.en: Chapter structure and chart annotation

desc.zh: 上面那些效果的技术底座。先只上平滑滚动，其余按需要再加。
desc.en: The technical base under everything above. Start with smooth scrolling alone and add the rest on demand.

why.zh: 平滑滚动，性价比最高的一个改动，几行代码换掉生硬的手感。
why.en: Smooth scrolling: the highest return per line of code, replacing a stiff scroll in minutes.

steal.zh: 直接加进任何现有页面
steal.en: Add it to any existing page

why.zh: 滚动、时间轴、逐帧动画的行业标准。
why.en: The industry standard for scroll, timeline and frame animation.

steal.zh: 复杂动效才需要，商用授权先确认
steal.en: Only for complex motion; check the commercial licence first

why.zh: 原 Framer Motion，React 项目里最顺手。
why.en: Formerly Framer Motion, the smoothest fit in React.

steal.zh: 列表进出、卡片展开的过渡
steal.en: List transitions and card expansion

why.zh: 轻量、语法简单，做数字滚动和图标动画很好。
why.en: Lightweight with simple syntax, good for counting numbers and icon animation.

steal.zh: 数字往上滚的动效
steal.en: Numbers that count up

why.zh: 一行代码给列表加过渡，性价比极高。
why.en: One line adds transitions to a list. Extremely high return.

steal.zh: 筛选、排序时的列表过渡
steal.en: List transitions during filter and sort

why.zh: 可视化作关键帧，像做动画片一样调页面。
why.en: Visual keyframing: tune the page the way you would animate a film.

steal.zh: 需要精细编排动效时用
steal.en: When motion needs precise choreography

why.zh: 整屏滚动，一屏一节，演示感强。
why.en: Full-screen scrolling, one section per screen, with a strong presentation feel.

steal.zh: GPL-3.0，商用之前先确认
steal.en: GPL-3.0, confirm before commercial use

why.zh: 轮播与滑动的标配，卡片墙和案例墙都用它。
why.en: The default for carousels and swipes; used for card and case walls.

steal.zh: 卡片墙的滑动手感
steal.en: The swipe feel of a card wall

why.zh: 网页三维的完整方案，能做的东西最多。
why.en: The complete solution for 3D on the web, capable of the most.

steal.zh: 收益最高但也最重，最后再考虑
steal.en: Highest ceiling but heaviest; consider it last

why.zh: 用 React 的写法写 three.js，状态管理跟项目一致。
why.en: three.js written the React way, with state management that matches the rest of the project.

steal.zh: 三维场景的组件化写法
steal.en: Componentising a 3D scene

why.zh: 不用写三维代码，拖出来就能嵌进网页。
why.en: No 3D code needed; drag it together and embed it.

steal.zh: 想要三维但不想学 three.js 时的出口
steal.en: The escape hatch when you want 3D without learning three.js

why.zh: 交互动画交付，界面动效领域目前最好的选择。
why.en: Interactive animation handoff and currently the best choice for UI motion.

steal.zh: 界面里的动态图标、加载状态
steal.en: Animated icons and loading states in an interface

why.zh: 设计师出动画、开发直接用的标准格式。
why.en: The standard format for a designer to hand animation to a developer.

steal.zh: 图标动效、空状态插画
steal.en: Icon motion and empty-state illustrations

desc.zh: 看起来很难的效果，大部分已经有现成组件。按技术栈选一个底座就够。
desc.en: Most effects that look hard already have components. Pick one base for your stack and stay with it.

why.zh: 现在做高级感界面的默认底座，组件代码直接进你的项目。
why.en: The default base for a refined interface today; component code lands in your own project.

steal.zh: 卡片、表格、标签页的层级与间距
steal.en: Hierarchy and spacing in cards, tables and tabs

why.zh: 现成的动效组件：跑马灯、便当栅格、光束连线、程序坞，都是看起来很难的效果。
why.en: Ready-made motion components: marquees, bento grids, animated beams, docks. All the effects that look hard.

steal.zh: 直接拿这些效果拼首屏
steal.en: Assembling a hero out of them

why.zh: 原 NextUI，观感现代，动效自带。
why.en: Formerly NextUI: modern-looking with motion built in.

steal.zh: 快速搭出成体系的界面
steal.en: Building a coherent interface quickly

why.zh: 企业级中后台的成熟方案，国内项目最稳。
why.en: The mature choice for enterprise back-office systems, and the safest in Chinese projects.

steal.zh: 表格、表单和复杂交互
steal.en: Tables, forms and complex interaction

why.zh: 组件全、文档好，React 项目里上手快。
why.en: Complete components and good documentation; quick to pick up in React.

steal.zh: 配套的 hooks 与表单校验
steal.en: Its hooks and form validation

why.zh: 纯 CSS 组件类，任何技术栈都能用，改主题最方便。
why.en: Pure CSS component classes that work with any stack, and the easiest theming.

steal.zh: 一键换主题的做法
steal.en: Switching themes in one step

why.zh: 无样式的交互底座，可访问性做得最扎实。
why.en: Unstyled interaction primitives with the most solid accessibility.

steal.zh: 自己做组件时当底座
steal.en: A base for building your own components

why.zh: 上面这些库几乎都建在它上面。
why.en: Nearly every library above is built on it.

steal.zh: 先把设计变量定下来，再谈组件
steal.en: Fix the design tokens before touching components

why.zh: 大量发布会级的卡片、背景光效组件，代码可以直接复制。
why.en: A large set of launch-grade cards and background effects with copyable code.

steal.zh: 首屏背景与卡片光效（商业产品，注意授权）
steal.en: Hero backgrounds and card glow (commercial product; check the licence)

desc.zh: 要动手之前先去这些地方看。它们不是做法，是货源。
desc.en: Look here before you start. These are not techniques; they are where the material comes from.

why.zh: 全球网页设计评选榜，找成品灵感最快的地方。
why.en: The global web design awards. The fastest way to find finished inspiration.

steal.zh: 按 Site of the Day 扫一遍，收集版面结构
steal.en: Scan Site of the Day for layout structures

why.zh: 人工筛选的高质量网页库，比综合榜更克制。
why.en: A hand-curated library of high-quality sites, more restrained than the big awards lists.

steal.zh: 找干净而高级的版面参考
steal.en: Finding clean, elevated layouts

why.zh: 按行业和版面类型归档的落地页库，检索比刷榜高效。
why.en: Landing pages filed by industry and layout type. More efficient to search than to scroll an awards list.

steal.zh: 先定版面结构，再填内容
steal.en: Choosing the layout structure before writing content

why.zh: 不只给灵感，还给原理和可运行的代码，上手门槛最低。
why.en: Not just inspiration: explanations and working code. The lowest barrier to starting.

steal.zh: 照着它的示例改自己的页面
steal.en: Adapting one of its demos to your own page

why.zh: 真实 App 的截图与完整流程库，做某个 App 的界面时从这里找最快。
why.en: Screenshots and complete flows from real apps. The fastest place to start on a specific app interface.

steal.zh: 按行业筛，金融和投资类单独看
steal.en: Filter by industry; browse finance and investing separately

why.zh: 按界面元素检索的真实产品设计参考，颗粒度比截图库细。
why.en: Real product design references searchable by UI element; finer-grained than a screenshot library.

steal.zh: 找具体的图表页、设置页怎么排
steal.en: Seeing how a chart page or settings page is laid out

why.zh: 录屏式记录真实产品的操作流程，能看清点下去之后发生什么。
why.en: Screen-recorded flows from real products, showing what happens after the click.

steal.zh: 设计交互流程时的对照
steal.en: A benchmark when designing an interaction flow

why.zh: 按付费转化拆解真实 App 的界面，看的是设计背后的动机。
why.en: Dissects real apps by conversion step, so you see the motive behind the design.

steal.zh: 引导流程和付费页的写法
steal.en: Onboarding flows and paywall pages

why.zh: 按交互类型归类真实 App 的动效，找微交互很方便。
why.en: Real app motion filed by interaction type; handy for micro-interactions.

steal.zh: 加载、展开、切换的过渡方式
steal.en: Loading, expanding and switching transitions

why.zh: 把复杂数据讲成人人看得懂的图，做汇报最该学的一组。
why.en: Complex data turned into charts anyone can read. The single most useful reference for reporting.

steal.zh: 图注写法、色彩克制、结论前置
steal.en: Chart captions, restrained colour, conclusion first

why.zh: 新闻级图表规范，每张图都能独立看懂。
why.en: Newsroom-grade chart discipline: every chart stands on its own.

steal.zh: 图表标题直接写结论
steal.en: Writing the conclusion in the chart title

why.zh: 用滚动和交互讲故事的天花板，视觉化叙事的范本。
why.en: The ceiling for storytelling with scroll and interaction, and a model for visual narrative.

steal.zh: 数据叙事的分镜设计
steal.en: Storyboarding a data narrative

why.zh: 信息图的另一种路数，复杂关系画成一张图。
why.en: A different route for infographics: complex relationships drawn as a single image.

steal.zh: 一张图讲清一个复杂议题
steal.en: Explaining a complex issue in one image

why.zh: 图表规范、配色、注释方式都值得直接照搬。
why.en: Chart conventions, colour and annotation all worth adopting wholesale.

steal.zh: 统一配色体系加清晰图例
steal.en: One colour system with clear legends

why.zh: 中英双语环境下的信息图，最贴近香港读者的阅读习惯。
why.en: Infographics in a bilingual environment, closest to how Hong Kong readers actually read.

steal.zh: 中英混排的图表标注
steal.en: Chart labelling with mixed Chinese and English

why.zh: 中文语境下的数据叙事，最贴近你的受众。
why.en: Data storytelling written for a Chinese audience, closest to your readers.

steal.zh: 中文标题写法、图表里的中文排版
steal.en: Chinese headline writing and Chinese typography inside charts

why.zh: 面向大众的数据栏目，把专业内容降维讲清楚。
why.en: A mass-market data desk that makes specialist material legible to everyone.

steal.zh: 给非专业读者的解释顺序
steal.en: The order in which things are explained to non-specialists

why.zh: 专做这类页面的顶级团队，作品集本身就是最好的参考库。
why.en: A top-tier studio for exactly this kind of page; its portfolio is the reference library.

steal.zh: 每个项目拆解它的入场动效与转场
steal.en: Break each project down into its entrance motion and transitions

why.zh: 滚动叙事与三维结合得非常顺，节奏控制是教科书级。
why.en: Scroll narrative fused smoothly with 3D; the pacing is textbook.

steal.zh: 画面节奏与色彩克制度
steal.en: Pacing and colour restraint

why.zh: 互动创意做得大胆，适合找「敢一点」的做法。
why.en: Bold interactive work, useful when you need something braver.

steal.zh: 把互动机制当成叙事的一部分
steal.en: Treating the interaction itself as part of the story

why.zh: 大品牌官网的专业户，结构清晰、执行稳。
why.en: Specialists in big-brand sites: clear structure, reliable execution.

steal.zh: 企业级官网的信息结构
steal.en: Information architecture for an enterprise site

why.zh: 自己开源了滚动叙事引擎，官网就是那套引擎的展示。
why.en: They open-sourced their scroll narrative engine; the site is the demo of it.

steal.zh: 把官网当成技术方案的说明书
steal.en: Treating the site as documentation for the technique

why.zh: 把极简排版做到极致，页面几乎只有字和动效。
why.en: Minimal typography pushed to its limit; almost nothing but type and motion.

steal.zh: 只用排版也能撑起一页
steal.en: Carrying a whole page with typography alone

why.zh: 平滑滚动库的开发者，官网手感就是标准答案。
why.en: The makers of the smooth-scroll library; their site is the reference implementation.

steal.zh: 滚动的手感和缓动曲线
steal.en: Scroll feel and easing curves

why.zh: 互动广告出身，擅长把复杂交互做得轻松。
why.en: From interactive advertising; good at making complex interaction feel effortless.

steal.zh: 让用户不动脑就知道下一步
steal.en: Signalling the next step without making anyone think

why.zh: 投资类 App 的界面范式，信息密度和视觉层次的标杆。
why.en: The interface paradigm for investing apps, and a benchmark for density and hierarchy.

steal.zh: 持仓页与行情页的组织方式
steal.en: How positions and quotes pages are organised

why.zh: 个人理财 App 里设计口碑最好的之一，图表和分类做得极细。
why.en: Among the best-designed personal finance apps; charts and categories are finely done.

steal.zh: 消费分类与趋势图的配色
steal.en: Colour in category and trend charts

why.zh: 专业投研终端里界面最清爽的一个，图表密度高但不挤。
why.en: The cleanest interface among professional research terminals: dense charts that still breathe.

steal.zh: 多图同屏时的间距与分区
steal.en: Spacing and zoning when several charts share a screen

why.zh: 金融图表交互的行业基准，缩放和标注的手感最好。
why.en: The industry benchmark for financial chart interaction; zooming and annotation feel best here.

steal.zh: 图表上的标注与区间选择
steal.en: Annotation and range selection on a chart

why.zh: 把资产总览做成一张图，个人财务的仪表盘范式。
why.en: The whole net worth in one view; a dashboard paradigm for personal finance.

steal.zh: 总览页的层级安排
steal.en: The hierarchy of an overview page

why.zh: 开源的投研终端，界面专业，能在本地完整跑起来。
why.en: An open-source investment research terminal with a professional interface that runs locally.

steal.zh: 研究报告页与数据表的组织方式
steal.en: How research pages and data tables are organised

why.zh: 开源个人理财应用，界面精致程度在开源界罕见，已停止维护但代码仍可参考。
why.en: An open-source personal finance app with rare polish for open source. No longer maintained, but the code still reads well.

steal.zh: 图表配色与卡片层级
steal.en: Chart colour and card hierarchy

why.zh: 开源投资组合跟踪工具，正好对应多资产配置这个场景。
why.en: An open-source portfolio tracker, matching the multi-asset allocation scenario directly.

steal.zh: 组合配置页与资产分布图
steal.en: Allocation pages and asset distribution charts

why.zh: 开源预算应用，交互响应快，前端实现干净。
why.en: An open-source budgeting app with fast interaction and a clean front-end.

steal.zh: 表格类界面的键盘操作
steal.en: Keyboard-first operation in table interfaces

why.zh: 不写代码就能做可交互长报告，年报和专题页模板很多。
why.en: Interactive long-form reports with no code, with plenty of annual-report and feature templates.

steal.zh: 要快速出对外长页时用
steal.en: When an external long page is needed quickly

why.zh: 设计自由度最高的交互内容平台，营销侧用得最多。
why.en: The most design-flexible interactive content platform, most used on the marketing side.

steal.zh: 不写代码做复杂版式
steal.en: Complex layout without writing code

why.zh: 图表和信息图模板最全的在线工具。
why.en: The online tool with the most complete chart and infographic templates.

steal.zh: 需要大量模板时按需取用
steal.en: Pulling templates when volume matters

why.zh: 公开作品库，能看到别人怎么做联动和筛选。
why.en: A public gallery showing how others build cross-filtering and linking.

steal.zh: 多图联动的公开案例
steal.en: Public examples of linked charts
